NOTE
**Still not ready: the guide's steps aren't finished, and the maintainer on #37289 hasn't weighed in**

New: The author updated the description with a prior-work section and credit, but pushed no code since the feedback. Missing: the work is still one new commit with a co-author line rather than building on #37289's commits as the guide describes, and there is no sign that @prakhar1144, who said on 2026-09-04 he plans to finish #37289 this cycle, agrees to this replacing it.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Before this can move forward, please follow the [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html) fully: build on the original commits from #37289 instead of squashing them into one new commit, and check with @prakhar1144 (who is planning to finish #37289) whether he wants this PR to replace it.
```
